hours: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday: 8 am–4 pm. After hours by appointment for dental emergencies.
facts: Family practice founded by Dr. Frederick Loe in 1957, continued by his son Thomas Loe.
Thomas Loe graduated from USC School of Dentistry.
Practice welcomes new patients; office speaks Spanish.
Published services include examinations/cleanings, fillings, crowns, implant crowns, bridges, dentures, bonding, veneers and whitening.
Practice lists most PPO insurance; coverage should be confirmed with office.
opportunities: Lead with the distinctive two-generation Culver City story, currently on the Our Practice page.
Unify the contact route: Contact Us displays loethomas@gmail.com / 310-251-7828 while the same page footer and homepage show culverdentist@yahoo.com / 310-838-3177.
Make new-patient details, office hours and a clear appointment request easier to scan; existing site uses generic contact form.
